svg.text: Core records: complete columns and declared foreign keys from the current local database
A follow-up or admission inserts a consultation into case_visits
and keeps the original health_cases record.
The date of birth is birthdate. The case outcome is status. Recorded
severity is a separate value. Age groups are derived from age at the case
date. No sex/gender field is collected.
E1 users.role: bhw / mho / admin / superadmin
E2 users.status: pending / approved / denied / suspended
E4 health_cases.severity: Mild / Monitored / High Risk
E5 health_cases.disease_review_status: Recorded / Pending / Clarification / Reviewed
E7 case_visits.nature_of_visit: New consultation/case / New admission / Follow-up visit
E8 case_visits.severity: Mild / Monitored / High Risk
PK primary key | FK declared foreign key
UK unique key | N: Y nullable, - required
Arrows link tables; exact FK columns are listed below each table. U = unsigned.
Local schema verified 19 October 2026. Metadata only; no patient records included.
